{{Quote|Did that happen in the war? Did you get it fighting a droideka?''"<br />"''It was just a regular battle droid. But, yes, we've seen some action&hellip;''"<br />"''I bet you were very brave.|[[Kennan Taanzer]] and a BARC trooper.|<ref name="Dark Times 6" />}}
'''Biker Advanced Recon Commandos''', known simply as '''BARC troopers''' or '''BARC pilots''', were specialized [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] that were trained to operate the [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]], which was named after them. Distinguished by their unique [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] BARC [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and later served under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as [[clone stormtrooper]]s.

==Description==
===Overview===
Biker Advanced Recon Commandos,<ref name="Friday Feature">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20Sneak%20Peek:%20New%20Rideable%20Mounts%20and%20Speeder|text=Friday Feature Sneak Peek: New Rideable Mounts and Speeder}}</ref> known simply as BARC [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]<ref name="Hasbro BARC">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=BARC Speeder with BARC Trooper|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/rots05BARCspeeder.asp}}</ref> or BARC [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], were specialized [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] that were trained to drive the [[BARC speeder/Legends|Biker Advanced Recon Commando speeder]], which was originally named and designed for them.<ref name="Chronicles" /> Due to their specialized training, BARC troopers could operate their speeders over hazardous terrain at over 500 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]].<ref name="Vehicles 43">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 43|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 43]]</ref> Some BARC troopers were also trained as [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]].<ref name="Hasbro BARC" />

As elite [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], BARC troopers were sent on highly dangerous missions during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Hasbro BARC" /> and were highly flexible in where they fought.<ref name="Vehicles 43" /> Multiple units fielded BARC troopers during the war, including the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]],<ref name="SWE3" /> the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Triton Squad]],<ref name="Descent">{{CWACite|4|Descent (comic story)}}</ref> the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]],<ref name="Vehicles 43" /> and a [[Unidentified squad (Eriadu)|squad]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="Tsui Choi BARC">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|text=''Star Wars: Order 66'' (Series 2)|pack=#3: Tsui Choi & BARC Trooper|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TACorder66-3.asp}}</ref>

===Equipment and armor===
[[File:CommanderNeyo-FFp19.png|thumb|left|200px|BARC troopers wore specialized Phase II clone trooper armor.]]
[[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] BARC troopers wore specialized [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with a unique [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] based on the helmet worn by [[clone assassin]]s,<ref name="Vehicles 43" /> equipped with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor feeds]] that enhanced performance and reaction time,<ref name="Chronicles" /> as well as an enhanced [[Breath mask/Legends|breath filter]].<ref name="Insider 130">{{InsiderCite|130|Ask Lobot}}</ref> Some BARC troopers customized their Phase II [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with an added [[ARC command sash]] and further distinguished their armor with [[Color/Legends|colored]] markings that designated their unit affiliation.<ref name="SWE3 VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> BARC trooper helmets could also be equipped with [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]].<ref name="Chronicles" /> BARC troopers that were trained as [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]] wore camouflaged [[clone scout trooper armor]].<ref name="Hasbro BARC" />

Although they were considered [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], Biker Advanced Recon Commandos also fought separately from their vehicles and were known to wield different [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] during the war,<ref name="SWE3 3" /> including [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]], [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]],<ref name="Sideshow Neyo">{{SideshowCite|set=Militaries of Star Wars|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=Commander Neyo|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Commander_Neyo_Star_Wars_Sideshow_Collectibles.asp}}</ref> [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]], [[WESTAR-M5 blaster rifle]]s,<ref name="Descent" /> [[Chaingun/Legends|chainguns]], and [[electromagnetic pulse launcher]]s. As their name implied, the main weapon and vehicle of the Biker Advanced Recon Commandos was the BARC [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]. It gave the troopers increased mobility and the ability to carry more firepower than the standard [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]].<ref name="Hasbro BARC" />

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
[[File:BARC_comm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Due to the speeder's rise in popularity with normal clone troopers, Biker Advanced Recon Commandos were no longer the sole drivers of the BARC speeder by the end of the war.]]
Originally created to operate the Galactic Republic's BARC speeders, Biker Advanced Recon Commandos were the first soldiers to use the vehicle during the Clone Wars, before it was eventually given out to other clone troopers due to its immense popularity in the Grand Army of the Republic.<ref name="Hasbro Cody">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=BARC Speeder Bike with Clone Commander Cody|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWDLXBARC-Cody.asp}}</ref> 

Seeing deployment as early as [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], BARC trooper [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]] brought his [[DUM-series pit droid]] [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]] to the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Jedi Temple communication center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Secret Weapons" /> Later, Neyo attended the [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]] aboard the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|''Valor'']] [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="No Return">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>  BARC troopers were also active in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], seeing action during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], where BARC troopers faced Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on the [[Beach/Legends|beaches]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].<ref name="SWE3 3" /> 

Following the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]] in 19 BBY,<ref name="SWE3" /> clone BARC troopers of the 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps patrolled the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface, before receiving [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The 91st's BARC troopers, including [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] Neyo and [[CT-3423]], enacted the order&mdash;[[Death/Legends|killing]] their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]].<ref name="Hasbro Saleucami">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=Treachery on Saleucami|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tacbpsaleucami.asp}}</ref> The 91st's BARC troopers also [[Massacre on Bogden 3|enacted the order]] on [[Bogden 3]], executing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Sian Jeisel]] and [[Du Mahn]].<ref name="Dark Times 6" />

===Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|Blast! Where did it go?''"<br />"''What does it matter? The Jedi are dead&mdash;most of 'em. Those left are scattered.''"<br />"''Order 66 remains in effect. We see one, we kill it. Same as the rest.|A clone stormtrooper officer and an Imperial BARC trooper.|<ref name="Purge" />}}
[[File:Clones-SWPurge.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Imperial BARC troopers hunt down Tsui Choi.]]
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], all clone troopers were reorganized as [[clone stormtrooper]]s of the new Imperial regime.<ref name="Republic Holonet 16524">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> On the planet Eriadu, a [[squad/Legends|squad]] of Imperial BARC troopers, led by a [[Unidentified clone stormtrooper|clone trooper commander]], attempted to execute Order 66 on [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], but were all killed in the process by the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master.<ref name="Purge" /> 

On Kashyyyk, Biker Advanced Recon Commmandos of Triton Squad assisted in the [[enslavement of Kashyyyk]], helping [[Fire/Legends|burn]] down [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] settlements on the planet, but were eventually thwarted and killed by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]].<ref name="Descent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Biker Advanced Recon Commandos first appeared, albeit unnamed, in {{Film|III}}, a [[2005]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="SWE3" /> They were later identified in a teaser for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'' expansion for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], hosted on the game's official website in the same year.<ref name="Friday Feature" />
